senses.gloss: (b. h.; √אר , cmp. Schr. KAT p. 497 ארג; cmp. also גדל to plait,to be tall) to be [pointed, stretched,] long, tall.

units: <cite ref="Mishnah Berakhot 1:4">Ber. I, 4</cite> <he>אמרו להַאֲרִיךְ</he> they commended a lengthy benediction.
Yoma 35ᵇ הֶאֱ׳ בתפלתו staid long in prayer.—הא׳ ימים to live long.

Ber. 8ᵇ, a. fr. מַאֲרִיכִין ימיו his life will be prolonged.—פנים, הא׳ רוח to be long-suffering, forbearing. Y. Shebu. IV, beg. 35ᵇ; a. fr.—Y. Taan. II, 65ᵇ bot. when collecting debts (punishing) מאריך וגובה he is slow in collecting (punishes in long intervals, gives extension).
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 20">Num. R. s. 20</cite>, end <he>הא׳ הברזל</he> the point of the spear grew longer, v. infra; a. fr.

senses.gloss: [to lengthen the carrying pole,] to make heavy.
units: <cite ref="Niddah 16b:14">Nidd. 16ᵇ</cite> <he>כמה הֶאֱרַכְתָּ עלינו</he> how heavy thou hast made our burden (through restrictive laws)!
<cite ref="Sifrei Bamidbar 131">Sifré Num. 131</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 771">Yalk. ib. 771</cite>; (Num. R. l. c. <cite ref="A03125"><he>האריך</he></cite>).
